;Armed conflict and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**Fighting resumes in rebel-held northwestern [[Syria]], as [[Government of Syria|government]] forces capture four villages by making their first large-scale push against rebel groups since the ceasefire that ended the [[Northwestern Syria offensive (April–August 2019)|2019 northwestern Syria offensive]] earlier this year. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/syrian-troops-make-push-rebel-held-northwest-idlib-67856263 (ABC News)]
*[[Citizenship Amendment Act protests]]
**Further clashes between protesters and [[law enforcement in India|police]] in the northern [[states and union territories of India|state]] of [[Uttar Pradesh]] leaves six people dead. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/killed-india-anti-citizenship-law-protests-rumble-191220171811195.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Business and economy
*[[Japan]] announces it will raise [[Japan Self-Defense Forces|military]] spending (1.1%) for an eighth consecutive year to a record high as it invests in [[ballistic missile]] and air defence to counter a perceived threat from [[North Korea]] and [[China]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-japan-economy-budget-defence/japan-government-approves-eighth-straight-defense-spending-hike-to-record-high-idUSKBN1YO05N (Reuters)]

;International relations
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Prosecutor of the International Criminal Court|Chief Prosecutor]] of the [[International Criminal Court]] [[Fatou Bensouda]] announces she will launch a full investigation into allegations of [[war crime]]s in the [[Palestinian territories]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/icc-investigate-alleged-war-crimes-palestinian-territories-191220143949348.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Iran–Japan relations]]
**[[Iran|Iranian]] [[President of Iran|President]] [[Hassan Rouhani]] meets with [[Prime Minister of Japan|Prime Minister]] [[Shinzō Abe]] in [[Tokyo]] to discuss renewing the [[Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action|Iranian nuclear deal]]. Rouhani is the first Iranian president to visit Japan in over 19 years. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/iran-rouhani-visits-japan-nuclear-deal-impasse-191220153826601.html (Al Jazeera)]
* [[The Two Popes]] film is released on [[Netflix]] just before the holiday season. It has a limited theatrical release during November in the [[United States]] and [[United Kingdom]]. [[Jonathan Pryce]] as [[Pope Francis]] gives a dramatic interpretation of a series of conversations that took place between the liberal cardinal and the conservative incumbent [[Pope Benedict XVI|Pope Benedict]] (played by [[Anthony Hopkins]]). [https://www.screendaily.com/features/jonathan-pryce-on-playing-pope-francis-in-the-two-popes-hes-a-flawed-character/5145379.article (Screen Daily)]

;Law and crime
*[[Climate justice]], [[Climate change mitigation]]
**In ''[[State of the Netherlands v. Urgenda Foundation|Urgenda Foundation v. State of the Netherlands]]'', the [[Supreme Court of the Netherlands]] upholds a 2015 ruling that "protection from the potentially devastating [[Effects of global warming|effects of climate change]]" is a [[human rights|human right]], ordering the [[Cabinet of the Netherlands|Dutch government]] to cut [[Greenhouse gas#Direct greenhouse gas emissions|greenhouse gas emissions]] by at least 25% by the end of 2020 compared to 1990 levels. [http://climatecasechart.com/non-us-case/urgenda-foundation-v-kingdom-of-the-netherlands/ (climatecasechart.com)] [https://apnews.com/5534fe18ac5352ba43c74c9a64d6a20a (AP)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Brexit]]
**The [[House of Commons of the United Kingdom]] votes 358–234 to pass the [[Government of the United Kingdom|government]]'s [[Brexit withdrawal agreement]] for the [[United Kingdom]] to leave the [[European Union]] on 31 January 2020. The bill will now head to the [[House of Lords]] for final approval. The bill also rules out extending trade talks with the EU beyond 31 December 2020, known as the "transition period". [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-50870939 (BBC News)]

;Science and technology
*[[Boeing Orbital Flight Test]]
**An [[Atlas V#Variants|Atlas V N22]] rocket successfully launches the first space-faring [[Boeing CST-100 Starliner|Boeing Starliner]] spacecraft during the [[Boeing Orbital Flight Test|Boe-OFT]] mission. However, an issue with the spacecraft's [[mission elapsed time]] clock immediately after launch causes the premature depletion of the spacecraft's attitude control fuel, precluding the spacecraft's planned rendezvous with the [[International Space Station]]. An early reentry and landing of the spacecraft at the [[White Sands Missile Range]] is planned for 22 December. [https://www.npr.org/2019/12/20/790098677/in-uncrewed-test-boeings-starliner-capsule-fails-to-reach-space-station (NPR)]
*[[Twitter suspensions]]
**[[Twitter]] bans almost 6,000 accounts, alleging that they were "amplifying messages favourable to Saudi authorities" in a [[Saudi Arabia|Saudi state]]-backed coordination. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-50872118 (BBC News)]
